_comment: Applied by vm/metabase_content.py (D109). Times are relative to the latest day in the data, not today.
name: Machine health
description: For the technicians: what is broken now, what has waited longest, which faults are rising, and how long repairs take.

cards.name: Out of order now
cards.description: Machines an open ticket took off the floor: nobody can play them.
sql: SELECT f.venue_code AS venue, f.machine_id, f.title, t.status, t.symptom, t.technician,
t.opened_at, t.downtime_hours
FROM annex_api.machine_floor f
LEFT JOIN annex_api.service_log t ON t.machine_id = f.machine_id AND t.status <> 'closed' AND t.took_machine_off_floor
WHERE f.out_of_order
ORDER BY t.opened_at

cards.name: Open tickets by age
cards.description: Every ticket not closed yet, oldest first. Age in days up to the latest day in the data.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT l.d - (t.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Ljubljana')::date AS age_days, t.ticket_id,
t.current_venue_code AS venue, t.title, t.status, t.symptom, t.technician, t.took_machine_off_floor AS machine_down
FROM annex_api.service_log t, l
WHERE t.status <> 'closed'
ORDER BY t.opened_at

cards.name: Coil and switch faults per day, 60 days
cards.description: Coil and switch faults the machines reported, per day, over the last 60 days. A rising line means a machine is about to need a technician.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.machine_events_daily)
SELECT e.day, replace(e.event_type, '_', ' ') AS fault, sum(e.events) AS faults
FROM annex_api.machine_events_daily e, l
WHERE e.day > l.d - 60 AND e.event_type IN ('coil_fault', 'switch_fault')
GROUP BY e.day, e.event_type ORDER BY e.day

cards.name: Downtime hours by venue, 90 days
cards.description: Hours machines were off the floor, by the venue where they stand now, for tickets opened in the last 90 days.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT max(day) AS d FROM annex_api.daily_plays)
SELECT coalesce(t.current_venue_code, 'storage') AS venue, sum(t.downtime_hours) AS downtime_hours
FROM annex_api.service_log t, l
WHERE (t.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Ljubljana')::date > l.d - 90 AND t.downtime_hours IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY downtime_hours DESC

cards.name: Mean time to repair by technician, 180 days
cards.description: Average hours from report to closed, for tickets closed in the data (180 days), per technician, with how many they closed.
sql: SELECT t.technician, round(avg(extract(epoch FROM (t.closed_at - t.opened_at)) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS mean_hours_to_repair,
count(*) AS tickets
FROM annex_api.service_log t
WHERE t.closed_at IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.technician ORDER BY mean_hours_to_repair

cards.name: Tickets by symptom, 180 days
cards.description: The 15 symptoms reported most often, over all tickets in the data (180 days).
sql: SELECT t.symptom, count(*) AS tickets
FROM annex_api.service_log t
GROUP BY t.symptom ORDER BY tickets DESC, t.symptom
LIMIT 15

cards.name: Parts cost per month
cards.description: Cost of the parts used on tickets, by the month they were opened. The first and the last month are partial.
sql: SELECT date_trunc('month', t.opened_at AT TIME ZONE 'Europe/Ljubljana')::date AS month, sum(t.parts_cost_eur) AS parts_cost_eur
FROM annex_api.service_log t
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
